title: Shrike Config
description: The camelCase configuration accepted by the Shrike CLI and passed to the Rust engine after host-only options are removed. A minimal empty object is valid and produces the documented defaults. Unknown keys are rejected by the host's schema validation when a project opts in.

ignore.description: Glob set skipped during inventory. Ignore wins over include.

tsconfig.description: tsconfig used for paths and baseUrl resolution. Default: "tsconfig.json".

cacheDir.description: Content-addressed cache directory, safe to delete. Default: ".shrike/cache".

entryPolicy.description: Entry seeding policy. local includes test and local-tooling entries; production excludes test-only entries. Default: "local".

testEntries.description: Include test, storybook, and fixture entries when entryPolicy is local. Default: true.

includeGenerated.description: Treat generated files as deletion candidates. Generated files are always parsed for edges. Default: false.

clientBoundaryPolicy.description: How `"use client"` files seed liveness. graph (default) lets normal import reachability decide; protect also seeds every export in a client-boundary file as an entry. Default: "graph".

serverActionPolicy.description: How `"use server"` modules seed liveness. graph (default) treats actions as ordinary exports and reports actions with no project reference; protect seeds every export in a server-action module as an entry. Default: "graph".

ignoreDependencies.description: Dependency names that are never reported as unused by `shrike scan` or `shrike deps`. Default: [].

publicApi.description: Extra repository-relative globs whose exports are public API and never deletion candidates. Default: [].

generated.description: Extra repository-relative globs treated as generated. Default: [].

batchPolicy.description: Blast-radius cap. Defaults: maxSymbols 50, maxFiles 10, maxLiveGraphPercent 5, allowOversized false.

entryAdapters.description: Framework adapters to enable. Unknown names are ignored with a warning. Default: ["next-app","next-pages","react","packages","tests","configs"].

checks.description: Project checks in execution order. When non-empty, these replace script discovery. Default: [].

pr.description: Pull-request options. Defaults: draft true, labels ["shrike","cleanup"], branchPrefix "shrike/cleanup", commentReceipt true, base null, title "Shrike: verified cleanup".

verification.description: Verifier options. Defaults: mode worktree, allowDirty false, tier standard, baselinePath ".shrike/baseline.json".

build.description: Optional Next.js build-graph evidence. Defaults: evidence false, snapshot ".next/analyze.jsonl", requireEvidence false.

maxLiveGraphPercent.description: Maximum percent of the live graph a batch may remove. Default: 5.

allowOversized.description: Allow an oversized SCC with an explicit, recorded override. Default: false.

name.description: Stable check name, for example typecheck.

command.description: Exact shell command. The verifier never guesses from a script name when this is supplied.

required.description: A required check blocks a verified outcome. Default: true.

reruns.description: Rerun count for flaky classification. Default: 0 (1 for tests is recommended).

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the worktree. Default: ".".

draft.description: Open the cleanup PR as a draft. Default: true.

labels.description: Labels applied to the PR. Default: ["shrike","cleanup"].

commentReceipt.description: Post the receipt as a PR comment. Default: true.

base.description: Base branch for the PR. Default: null, which uses the plan's base ref or main.

mode.description: Apply mode. worktree is the default; in-place requires a clean tree unless allowDirty is set. Default: "worktree".

allowDirty.description: Allow verification on a dirty tree. Worktree mode still refuses because it cannot be reproduced from a commit. Default: false.

tier.description: Check tier. fast is typecheck+lint, standard adds test, full adds build. Default: "standard".

baselinePath.description: Baseline file path relative to the repository. Default: ".shrike/baseline.json".

evidence.description: Consume next analyze export evidence by default. Default: false.

snapshot.description: Path to the JSONL build export. Default: ".next/analyze.jsonl".

requireEvidence.description: Fail closed with exit 4 when evidence is absent, stale, malformed, or unsupported. Default: false.
